parameters.query: INSERT INTO auction_notices (chat_id, file_name, sha256, markdown, deterministic, analysis) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, sha256) DO UPDATE SET   analysis = EXCLUDED.analysis,   deterministic = EXCLUDED.deterministic,   created_at = now() RETURNING id, chat_id, created_at;
